name: Teach
description: Tutors the user on any topic across sessions, keeping mission, HTML lessons, reference sheets and learning records in the current directory.
longDescription:
Runs a multi-session course from the current directory for any subject (its examples span code, physics and yoga), invoked as `/teach`. The workspace holds:

- **Mission** (`MISSION.md`): why the user is learning; every lesson is tied to it
- **Lessons** (`lessons/*.html`): self-contained, one win each, citing a primary source
- **Reference** (`reference/*.html`): printable cheat sheets and glossaries
- **Learning records** (`learning-records/*.md`): ADR-style insights steering the next lesson
- **`RESOURCES.md`**, **`assets/`** (shared stylesheet, quiz widgets), **`NOTES.md`**

Lessons use retrieval practice, spacing and interleaving; real-world questions are handed to communities.
